name: Water Flask
description: Maren's old flask. Lexlings get thirsty on the road.

name: Sunberries
description: A pouch of sweet, sticky berries. They grow all over Lexora, so the pouch never stays empty for long.

name: Good Stick
description: Every adventurer needs a good stick, says Maren. Milo is not convinced.

name: Translator's Charm
description: A carved wooden charm. Every Translator carries one. Maren wouldn't say why.

name: Shiny Stone
description: Milo found it in Whisperwood. It glows faintly whenever he's close.

name: Puffkin Fluff
description: A wisp a Puffkin left behind. It drifts upward if you let go.
